nodes.text: Acidify NH3 solution with HNO3 to see if precipitate reforms, confirming AgCl

nodes.text: Precipitate reforms upon acidification with HNO3

nodes.text: Precipitate reforming on acidification confirms classic AgCl behavior: white ppt with Ag+, dissolves in NH3, reforms with acid

support.quote:
The precipitate reforms upon acidification with HNO3. This confirms the classic behavior of AgCl:
1. Forms white precipitate with Ag+
2. Dissolves in NH3 to form [Ag(NH3)2]+ complex
3. Reforms as AgCl precipitate when acidified
